desc: The Cima CF (Carbon Fiber) delivers for hunters who appreciate the balance and feel of a classic sporterstyle rifle. It's built for those who also demand modern innovation and reduced weight. While the industry continues to push toward lighter rifles, few have done so without compromising on performance and reliability. The Cima CF changes that. Engineered with cutting-edge materials and proprietary manufacturing methods, it's designed to deliver unwavering accuracy, repeatable performance, and rugged dependability in the harshest conditions.
